what: The section header label bounces back into place once, the moment its top edge touches the bottom of the screen: from .85 scale, 10px lower, transparent, with back.inOut(4) over 1.3s.

options.ease: Curve("0.68,-0.55,0.27,1.55" Same number or GSAP name), default back.inOut(4)
options.origin: Anchor point for growing and shrinking (transform-origin), default 50% 100% (fx.css) — popfade in one project is 65% 100%
